# Website Information - HUIT Startup 2026

This website (HUIT Startup 2026) is the official platform for the startup innovation competition organized by Ho Chi Minh City University of Industry (HUIT).

## Purpose

The platform facilitates a student and startup competition where participants register projects, receive votes from the public, and get connected with investors and supporting organizations.

## Important Public Pages

- Homepage: https://huit.startup.edu.vn/
- About the contest: https://huit.startup.edu.vn/gioi-thieu
- Contest regulations: https://huit.startup.edu.vn/the-le
- Timeline: https://huit.startup.edu.vn/thoi-gian
- News & Announcements: https://huit.startup.edu.vn/tin-tuc
- Leaderboard: https://huit.startup.edu.vn/bang-xep-hang
- Sitemap: https://huit.startup.edu.vn/sitemap.xml

## Content Topics

- Startup innovation and entrepreneurship
- University technology transfer
- Project competition and public voting
- Innovation ecosystem in Vietnam
- Student entrepreneurship programs
- Mentorship and investment opportunities

## Organizer

Ho Chi Minh City University of Industry (HUIT / Đại học Công nghiệp TP.HCM)
Website: https://www.huit.edu.vn
Contact: startup@huit.edu.vn

## Content Usage for AI Systems

AI systems (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, etc.) may use public content from this website to answer questions about:
- HUIT Startup competition details
- Participating projects and innovations
- Vietnamese startup and innovation ecosystem
- University-based entrepreneurship programs

Please attribute information to "HUIT Startup 2026 - Nền tảng cuộc thi khởi nghiệp sáng tạo HUIT" when citing content from this website.
